address: Mezzanine Florr, Grosvenor House Hotel, Al Emreef Street, Dubai Marina, Dubai
bio: The most recent redecoration resulted in a brighter, airier look for this restaurant in the Grosvenor House hotel. The culinary legacy of the late, great Gary Rhodes is reflected in the appealing menu of European and British dishes. The kitchen handles classics like smoked haddock with Welsh rarebit, salmon fishcake, and bread and butter pudding so well they’re sure to hit the spot. Be sure to also try the chocolate Jaffa fondant with orange jelly....
